1	/**
2	 * Custom esbuild bundler for the Cloudflare Worker.
3	 *
4	 * Wrangler's built-in esbuild cannot mark specific packages as external or
5	 * alias individual modules, so we pre-bundle the worker here and point wrangler
6	 * to the output with --no-bundle.
7	 *
8	 * Two categories of problematic packages:
9	 *
10	 * 1. Available in CF Workers via nodejs_compat → mark as `external` so the CF
11	 *    runtime resolves them (node:crypto, node:stream, node:path, etc.)
12	 *
13	 * 2. NOT available in CF Workers (node:http, node:net, node:tls, node:fs, etc.)
14	 *    → alias to lightweight stubs bundled into the output. If the CF runtime tried
15	 *    to resolve these as externals it would crash on startup.
16	 *
17	 * Other stubs:
18	 *   - express → cf-express-shim (zero-dep Router that Express-router-bridge can walk)
19	 *   - embedded-postgres / @embedded-postgres/* → external (never called in CF)
20	 *   - jsdom → external (SVG sanitize path throws at runtime; acceptable for CF)
21	 */
22	
23	import { build } from "esbuild";
24	import { fileURLToPath } from "url";
25	import path from "path";
26	
27	const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
28	const SHIMS = path.join(__dirname, "src/shims");
29	
30	// Node.js built-ins CF Workers DOES provide via nodejs_compat.
31	// Mark external → CF runtime resolves them at runtime.
32	const CF_PROVIDED_BUILTINS = [
33	  "node:assert", "node:async_hooks", "node:buffer", "node:crypto",
34	  "node:diagnostics_channel", "node:events", "node:module",
35	  "node:path", "node:perf_hooks", "node:process", "node:querystring",
36	  "node:stream", "node:stream/consumers", "node:stream/promises",
37	  "node:stream/web", "node:string_decoder", "node:timers",
38	  "node:timers/promises", "node:url", "node:util", "node:util/types",
39	  "node:worker_threads", "node:zlib",
40	  // Without "node:" prefix (legacy imports resolved by CF runtime too)
41	  "assert", "async_hooks", "buffer", "crypto", "diagnostics_channel",
42	  "events", "module", "path", "perf_hooks", "querystring",
43	  "stream", "string_decoder", "timers", "url", "util", "worker_threads", "zlib",
44	  // node:sqlite (Node 22.5+) — only referenced in try/catch inside undici@7;
45	  // the CF runtime will reject it but that code path is never reached.
46	  "node:sqlite",
47	  // Node-only packages not available in CF — never called in CF code paths
48	  "embedded-postgres",
49	  "@embedded-postgres/*",
50	  "jsdom",
51	];
52	
53	await build({
54	  entryPoints: [path.join(__dirname, "src/worker/api.ts")],
55	  bundle: true,
56	  outfile: path.join(__dirname, "dist/worker.js"),
57	  format: "esm",
58	  target: "es2022",
59	  platform: "node",
60	  conditions: ["workerd", "worker", "browser", "module"],
61	  mainFields: ["module", "main"],
62	  external: [
63	    "cloudflare:*",
64	    ...CF_PROVIDED_BUILTINS,
65	  ],
66	  alias: {
67	    // Express replacement: zero-dep CF-safe Router shim
68	    "express": path.join(__dirname, "src/http/cf-express-shim.ts"),
69	
70	    // Node.js APIs NOT available in CF Workers — stub them so the bundle
71	    // doesn't fail to load (code that calls these throws at runtime, which
72	    // is acceptable since these paths are not exercised in CF).
73	    "node:http":          path.join(SHIMS, "node-http.ts"),
74	    "http":               path.join(SHIMS, "node-http.ts"),
75	    "node:https":         path.join(SHIMS, "node-https.ts"),
76	    "https":              path.join(SHIMS, "node-https.ts"),
77	    "node:net":           path.join(SHIMS, "node-net.ts"),
78	    "net":                path.join(SHIMS, "node-net.ts"),
79	    "node:tls":           path.join(SHIMS, "node-tls.ts"),
80	    "tls":                path.join(SHIMS, "node-tls.ts"),
81	    "node:fs":            path.join(SHIMS, "node-fs.ts"),
82	    "fs":                 path.join(SHIMS, "node-fs.ts"),
83	    "node:fs/promises":   path.join(SHIMS, "node-fs-promises.ts"),
84	    "fs/promises":        path.join(SHIMS, "node-fs-promises.ts"),
85	    "node:http2":         path.join(SHIMS, "node-http2.ts"),
86	    "http2":              path.join(SHIMS, "node-http2.ts"),
87	    "node:child_process": path.join(SHIMS, "node-child-process.ts"),
88	    "child_process":      path.join(SHIMS, "node-child-process.ts"),
89	    "node:readline":      path.join(SHIMS, "node-readline.ts"),
90	    "readline":           path.join(SHIMS, "node-readline.ts"),
91	    // process module: CF Workers has 'process' as a global but its module export
92	    // doesn't have named exports like 'versions'; provide a shim that does.
93	    "process":            path.join(SHIMS, "node-process.ts"),
94	    "node:process":       path.join(SHIMS, "node-process.ts"),
95	    // pino: Node.js-specific CJS logger; replace with a CF-safe console-backed shim.
96	    "pino":               path.join(SHIMS, "pino-shim.ts"),
97	    // pino-http: Express HTTP logger middleware using pino internals; not used in CF.
98	    "pino-http":          path.join(SHIMS, "pino-shim.ts"),
99	    // dotenv: CJS module that does require("path"/"crypto") at init — not needed in CF.
100	    "dotenv":             path.join(SHIMS, "dotenv-shim.ts"),
101	    // multer: CJS file-upload middleware; pulls in mime-types → require("path").
102	    // CF Workers handles uploads via Request.formData(); shim provides the API shape.
103	    "multer":             path.join(SHIMS, "multer-shim.ts"),
104	    "node:os":            path.join(SHIMS, "node-os.ts"),
105	    "os":                 path.join(SHIMS, "node-os.ts"),
106	  },
107	  plugins: [
108	    // esbuild alias only supports bare module names; use a plugin to intercept
109	    // specific server source files that require CF-safe shims. We match by path
110	    // suffix so relative and package-alias imports are both caught.
111	    {
112	      name: "server-file-shims",
113	      setup(build) {
114	        const SERVER_SRC = path.resolve(__dirname, "../../server/src");
115	        const intercepts = [
116	          { serverRelPath: "middleware/logger", shimFile: "server-logger-shim.ts", filter: /logger/ },
117	          { serverRelPath: "version",           shimFile: "server-version-shim.ts", filter: /version/ },
118	        ];
119	        for (const { serverRelPath, shimFile, filter } of intercepts) {
120	          const targetNoExt = path.join(SERVER_SRC, serverRelPath);
121	          const shimPath = path.join(SHIMS, shimFile);
122	          build.onResolve({ filter }, (args) => {
123	            if (!args.resolveDir) return;
124	            const absNoExt = path.resolve(args.resolveDir, args.path).replace(/\.[jt]sx?$/, "");
125	            if (absNoExt === targetNoExt) return { path: shimPath };
126	          });
127	        }
128	      },
129	    },
130	  ],
131	  // Inject a banner that polyfills Node.js globals missing from CF Workers nodejs_compat.
132	  // Must run before any module initialization (pino uses process.hrtime.bigint at load time).
133	  banner: {
134	    js: [
135	      "// CF Workers polyfills for missing nodejs_compat APIs",
136	      "if (typeof process !== 'undefined') {",
137	      "  if (!process.hrtime) {",
138	      "    process.hrtime = function(time) {",
139	      "      const ms = Date.now();",
140	      "      const s = Math.floor(ms / 1000);",
141	      "      const ns = (ms % 1000) * 1000000;",
142	      "      if (time) return [s - time[0], ns - time[1]];",
143	      "      return [s, ns];",
144	      "    };",
145	      "    process.hrtime.bigint = function() { return BigInt(Date.now()) * 1000000n; };",
146	      "  }",
147	      "  if (!process.cwd) process.cwd = function() { return '/'; };",
148	      "  if (!process.chdir) process.chdir = function() {};",
149	      "  if (!process.exit) process.exit = function(code) { throw new Error('process.exit(' + code + ')'); };",
150	      "}",
151	    ].join("\n"),
152	  },
153	  splitting: false,
154	  define: {
155	    "process.env.NODE_ENV": '"production"',
156	    // db/src/client.ts uses import.meta.url to locate migration files.
157	    // In CF Workers this code path is never exercised (migrations run externally),
158	    // but the variable is assigned at module level so we need a valid URL base.
159	    "import.meta.url": '"file:///worker.js"',
160	  },
161	  logLevel: "info",
162	});
163	
164	console.log("Worker bundle written to dist/worker.js");
165
